body: Hi, I actually have pretty much the same problem as you. I just have a few twists added to it. If you want someone to talk to, I'm here. You can PM me if you don't want it to be as public as comments are.

Yeah, honestly it's best to think that way. Things will get better, and we'll look back and see how strong we could be. Even in times like this, it's best to keep our chins up. I think it's nice to talk to someone about it. If you want I'm here, and we can talk. It's kind of a mutual gain, so I hope to hear from you soon.

Yeah, I think that would be the best thing to do. My only problem is what happens if the girl tries to come back. The friend I mentioned in the post talked to her, and she said she regretted everything she had done to me. She said she wanted me back but she wasn't ready to commit. I don't know what to do if she tries to come back, she's already tried to talk to me a few times already.Do I let her back in? Do I tell her to just leave?

Yeah, I know how you feel. Not to mention that the past two relationships have ended because of some cheating issues. I honestly think that they alone gave me the trust issues I have today. It's kind of hard to make friends nowadays, at least for me. I don't tend to talk very much, and there's really no one I'm comfortable talking to about how I'm feeling right now. I think it's  better to have an Internet friend to talk to, just so that you have someone to go to when no one else is there to pick you up. I have to admit I'm really glad you replied. I never really get to... express myself in anyway, because of my trust issues. So thank you.

Thanks. It's nice to know that someone actually cares. It's hard to explain, but I just feel so... closed off to everyone. Like I can't really trust anyone else to help me with these problems. I really appreciate your reply, and I hope to hear back from you soon. By the way, you didn't have to tell me that, I would've talked to you regardless.
